operations.before:
_variable_subscript_expression: $ => seq(
        $._new_variable,
        seq('[', optional($.expression), ']'),
      ),

      _dereferencable_subscript_expression: $ => seq(
        $._dereferencable_expression,
        seq('[', optional($.expression), ']'),
      ),
operations.after:
_variable_subscript_expression: $ => seq(
        $._new_variable,
        choice(
          seq('[', optional($.expression), ']'),
          seq(token.immediate('{'), $.expression, '}'),
        ),
      ),

      _dereferencable_subscript_expression: $ => choice(
        seq(
          $._dereferencable_expression,
          seq('[', optional($.expression), ']'),
        ),
        prec(PREC.DEREF, seq($._variable, token.immediate('{'), $.expression, '}')),
      ),

clone_expression: $ => choice(
        prec.dynamic(1, seq(keyword('clone'), $.primary_expression)),
        seq(keyword('clone'), $.arguments),
      ),

[$.namespace_name],
      [$.heredoc_body],
      [$.parenthesized_expression, $.argument],
    ],

token.immediate('('),
          alias(keyword('set', false), $.operation),
          token.immediate(')'),

heredoc: $ => seq(
        token(seq(optional(/[bB]/), '<<<')),

nowdoc: $ => seq(
        token(seq(optional(/[bB]/), '<<<')),

exit_statement: $ => seq(
        choice(keyword('exit'), keyword('die')),
namespace_use_group: $ => seq('{', commaSep1($.namespace_use_clause), optional(','), '}'),

repeat1(choice(
          field('visibility', $.visibility_modifier),
          field('final', $.final_modifier),
          field('readonly', $.readonly_modifier),
        )),
        optional(field('type', $.type)), // Note

seq(
            optional(choice($.visibility_modifier, $.final_modifier)),
            $.name,
          ),
          seq(
            choice($.visibility_modifier, $.final_modifier),
            optional($.name),
          ),

expression_statement: $ => choice(
        seq($.expression, $._semicolon),
        seq(alias($.void_cast_expression, $.cast_expression), $._semicolon),
      ),

      void_cast_expression: $ => seq(
        '(',
        field('type', alias(keyword('void', false), $.cast_type)),
        ')',
        field('value', $.expression),
      ),

.end_word_indentation_allowed = false,                                                                         \
        .min_indent = INT32_MAX,                                                                                       \
